m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You say there actually was a Sani-Bot invasion? I mean... of course there was. I am Ben'ana Foster Kane. Yes, always yes.
Maybe I can fashion another conflict to avenge my old sled. But against which foes? The Shadow Foes!
What do you say? You supply the spells, I supply the war? No? Well, then off with you.
That was its name, the Sani-Bot that stormed into my house and caused me to drop my favorite snow globe upon the floor. It must be destroyed.
Not for vengeance... not just anyway... but for Zanadu! This is clearly more than a standard Sani-Bot malfunction. It is a prelude to invasion!
Not everyone thinks so. But I am Ben'ana Foster Kane and people will think what I tell them to think! Now go avert this hypothetical war.
What do you want? In the depths of your ignorance, what do you want? I sent you to get revenge... er, win a very real, actual war, didn't I?
